_note: JS comments inside a component start tag are threaded onto the prop or event they sit next to, as svelte2tsx does: a comment directly before an attribute is written on the line above that prop, and a comment after the tag's last attribute follows it. A `// @ts-expect-error` above a bad prop therefore suppresses its error, and one above a valid prop (or trailing the tag with nothing after it that errs) reports TS2578. Before, component in-tag comments were dropped, so the excess prop still errored and no TS2578 fired.
